component.name: Compositor
component.summary: A free, open-source, Photoshop-style image editor

description.p: Compositor is a full-featured image editor that is completely free and open source. It is built around a Photoshop-style compositing and post-processing workflow, with layers, masks, adjustment layers, transform, selections, painting and retouching tools, and a full set of adjustments and filters.
This is the Linux port: a Qt Widgets shell over a retained Swift core, with Skia compositing and OpenCV named operations, packaged as a Flatpak.

Upstream 1.5.5 on GNU/Linux: RGB Split, filter adjustment layers, Channel Pack with transparent RGB preservation, Split to Layers, Photoshop artboard tabs, and project format 16. Fix native font Undo and artboard conversion prompt ownership. Add a verbose terminal dashboard for Flatpak workflows.
Vendor pinned Linux dependency sources, licenses and offline build documentation
Fix Poppler-data license packaging for the upstream 1.5.4 Linux release.
Upstream 1.5.4 on Linux: pen pressure for brush size and opacity, searchable font previews, PDF pages imported as layers, new line styles and caps, and project format 15.
Linux: document parity evidence and remaining verification gaps; Linux: add optional Nautilus and Dolphin project previews; Linux: add independent render parity corpus and project launch verification
Linux: Smudge keeps up with a fast drag and releases faster; Linux: About shows 1.5.3 (49); the upstream gate fails when AppVersion.h is stale

RAW Develop and Add Noise/Grain now use upstream's own code unchanged; Live Add Noise and Grain run on the GPU (Vulkan); Gaussian noise matches the exported file exactly; Projects tab bar: a dragged tab stays above its neighbours; UI checks now cover the Export As sheet and the command palette.

RAW Lens Correction for files without their own profile, from the lensfun lens database; A default CMYK profile (SWOP TR005 Coated), so View › CMYK and CMYK export work without loading one; Select Subject and Remove Background follow the photo's edges more closely; Faster brushes and drags on large documents; no stall on a stroke's first frame; Command palette as on the Mac: its placeholder, No commands match, shortcuts in their own column; Window menu: Bring All to Front and the window entry; Export As preview: dragging the zoomed image pans it, and zooming keeps its middle; View › Clear Guides works; UI fixes: New Canvas preset menu, CMYK proof and gamut pills, unclipped slider titles, missing icons, Camera Raw scope layout.

Linux: adaptations and parity fixes for upstream 1.5.3; Merge upstream 1.5.3 into GNU_Linux; Publish update feed for Compositor 1.5.3; Version 1.5.3; Accelerate large Camera Raw previews with verified Metal lookup; Reduce Camera Raw scope sampling and benchmark preview latency; Keep Camera Raw previews at native resolution during adjustments; Update zoom cursors immediately when drag direction changes; Add middle-mouse dragging to scroll the layer list; Disable smooth corners when rectangle radius is zero; Add smooth rectangle corners and simplify shape controls; Remove temporary proof benchmark test committed by mistake

Compositor 1.5.2: CMYK proof colors and gamut warning on the canvas, CMYK JPEG/TIFF/PDF export and CMYK Photoshop files, 16-bit layers on the canvas at 16 bits, Progressive Blur, Camera Raw section resets and adaptive Shadows, RAW files opening into the Camera Raw Filter, and clearable shortcuts. Typed transform values preview live and number labels scrub again.

16-bit and HDR layers: 16-bit images keep their precision through every edit, EXR and Radiance HDR import with light brighter than white, EXR export, 8/16-bit conversion, paste an image to make a new canvas, and drops anywhere on the tab bar open a new project.
RAW Lens Correction: distortion and vignetting taken out from the profile in the file (DNG, Sony, Fujifilm, OM System/Olympus, Panasonic), on by default where a file has one, as on the Mac.
Catches up with Compositor 1.4.10: HEIF photos from Canon, Sony and Fuji cameras (.hif, .heif) import like HEIC; new app icon.
Flatpak Save As: allow Documents/Downloads for .comp directory packages; remap portal/tmpfs paths to a durable save location.
Save As installs .comp directory packages reliably; document-portal paths auto-save under Documents with the chosen name.
Show Controls arms Free Transform with Cancel (Esc) and Apply (Enter); Ctrl+T still enters Free Transform when controls are off.
Move / Free Transform: Ctrl+T persistent edit with aligned handle hitboxes, wider grab slop, and resize/rotate hover cursors on Linux.
Image › Curves (Ctrl+M) graph interaction works on Linux: map SwiftUI Color views so DragGesture hosts receive clicks.
About panel shows the Compositor app icon on Flatpak by resolving theme and /app/share icon paths.
Flatpak Updates dialog adds Restart Now after an install so the new commit launches after save prompts.
Maintenance alpha: drop the Linux UI e2e and graphics E2E bench harness from the tree; editor behavior unchanged from alpha.2.
Tip 1.4.5 Linux catch-up: live gradient preview, Copy Merged/Paste, Smudge/Liquify under 150 ms with a responsive release, Cut through every selected layer, and a Skia Ganesh Flatpak build fix.
Tip 1.4.5 Linux catch-up: live gradient preview, Copy Merged/Paste, Smudge/Liquify under 150 ms with a responsive release, and Cut through every selected layer.
Keep the newly created canvas when undoing all edits on GNU/Linux, preserving the initial layer, redo history, and unsaved document state.
Fix save and autosave crashes with SQLite-backed preferences, migrate existing settings, and verify preference persistence in installed Flatpak builds.
Signed Flatpak updates, Linux release downloads, and faster Gaussian and Motion Blur rendering.

First Linux Flatpak preview build of the port. Feature-aligned with macOS 1.0.4; not yet at full parity. Packages the portable C pixel kernels behind a Qt Widgets host shell with a Swift core on a C ABI.
